album_res = apis.spotify.search_albums(query='Velvet Underground', page_index=0, page_limit=20)
print('search_count', len(album_res))
# find exact title match
matches=[a for a in album_res if a.get('title')=='Velvet Underground']
print('matches_on_page0', [(m.get('album_id'), m.get('title')) for m in matches])
# if not found on page0, search all pages
if not matches:
    all_albums=[]
    i=0
    while True:
        res=apis.spotify.search_albums(query='Velvet Underground', page_index=i, page_limit=20)
        print('page',i,'count',len(res) if isinstance(res,list) else 'na')
        if not res:
            break
        all_albums.extend(res)
        i+=1
    matches=[a for a in all_albums if a.get('title')=='Velvet Underground']
print('total_matches',len(matches))
print(matches)
